query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = $1 AND inactivity_notice_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND inactivity_notice_at <= now() - make_interval(days => $2)
                 AND last_seen_at <= now() - make_interval(years => $3)
                 AND last_seen_at < inactivity_notice_at
           ) AS "due!"
